name: vault-browse-empty-folder
comment: Vault Browse face execution plan, Slice 9 (empty states): a confirmed root pointing at a genuinely empty directory (tests/fixtures/vault/browse-empty-folder-root, holding only a .gitkeep placeholder so the fixture tree survives git - VaultKit's own kind classifier treats a suffix-less dotfile as MediaKind::Unknown, a non-media leftover, so it never becomes a grid row). Run with --seed tests/fixtures/vault/browse-empty-folder-seed (an absolute path; its vault/config.json points a confirmed root directly at the empty fixture dir - VaultLibrary::republishAtBoot() scans+publishes any confirmed root automatically at boot, same mechanism vault_browse_smoke.json already relies on). Proves the design's §4.5 'this folder is genuinely empty' cause, distinct from 'no storage configured' - the browse face itself must render (rail + grid), not fall back to the pre-Vault onboarding screen, because a real confirmed root exists here.

steps.label: the session answers, drive gated on
one visible window, isolated data root
the boot splash has left the screen
open the Vault via the folder door
the browse face renders (a real confirmed root exists, unlike no-storage)
the rail shows the one confirmed root, available
the grid settles at zero - genuinely nothing here
the empty-cause component reports emptyFolder with the mock's exact copy

expect.value: Nothing here yet. Anything you drop in will appear on its own.
